root_cause: Local/on-prem and air-gapped choices were configurable in the Data Sovereignty Control Plane, but there was no separately deployable local-model routing contract with tenant, signed local readback, CSRD approval and strict loopback egress.
prevention: Never route local or air-gapped tenant prompts through hosted Bedrijfsgeheugen inference functions.
Require local operator isolation and independently signed, time-bounded tenant/use-case/model proof, including pinned model digest, network, storage/RAG and health readback.
Use existing Brain cross-domain approval for privacy, security, supplier, finance, sustainability and CSRD/ESRS scope, including explicit customer consent.
Accept only server-owned model endpoint inventory pinned to numeric localhost, error on redirects or failures, and never retry/fallback to cloud.
Do not claim real air-gap security, functioning hardware, measured emissions, RAG residency, or tenant deployment without independent live verification.

evidence.outcome: Local, strict signed runtime adapter foundation offered as protected PR; deployed customer hardware not proven
